parsed.answer: The evidence states that the TRF2-RTEL1 interaction is mediated by a metal-coordinating C4C4 motif in RTEL1, with the HHS mutation RTEL1(R1264H) compromising this interaction, and that a TRF2(I124D) substitution in the TRFH domain eliminates RTEL1 binding. This directly supports the claim that RTEL1 interacts with TRF2 through a C4C4 motif in RTEL1.
